title: Deeper at constant width: 8 -> 10 layers, dim stays 512
description: DEPTH 8 -> 10 and ASPECT_RATIO 64 -> 48, so model_dim stays 512 with 4 heads of 128; pure depth increase, nothing else touched.
reflection: Capacity is the binding constraint, not optimization. val_bpb 0.989143 vs baseline 0.997358 = -0.0082, roughly 9x the ~0.0009 noise floor and by far the largest move in the cell. The trade was real and still clearly worth it: FLOPs/token 2.39e8 -> 2.96e8 (+24%), so the run saw 380.4M tokens over 2902 steps instead of ~412M over ~3150. Two things I did not predict: steady-state MFU went UP (37.8% vs ~33%), because the deeper model amortizes the fixed per-step Muon/Python overhead over more useful work, which paid back part of the FLOP cost; and peak VRAM rose to 27.8GB (from 22.2), more than the +25% on block activations alone, so the headroom for going deeper again is smaller than the FLOP budget suggests. epoch stayed 1, so we are not repeating data and the capacity-over-tokens argument still holds at 380M tokens. Params 50.3M -> 60.8M.
